stem: Ishaan sorts four classroom samples: a copper wire, charcoal (carbon), a rubber eraser, and a wooden ruler. Metals and non-metals are classes of elements. Rubber and wood are everyday materials, not elements in those classes.

options.text: Copper is a metal element; carbon is a non-metal element; rubber and wood are materials not classed as metals or non-metals here.
The rubber eraser is a non-metal because it is not a metal.
The shiny wooden ruler is a metal because it looks polished.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Copper and carbon are elements (metal and non-metal). Rubber and wood are everyday materials, not elements sorted into those classes.

teacher.key_rationale: Metals and non-metals classify elements. Copper is a metal and carbon a non-metal; rubber and wood are materials outside those element classes. Shine alone does not make wood a metal.
